test_case.test_name: AMI AutoVideoSettings OEM Redfish schema and policy validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the literal AMI AutoVideoSettings resource returns the approved firmware-specific schema and current video-policy values for the installed topology and state.
test_case.test_command: After the OEM oracle is approved, issue one TLS-validated secret-safe GET to the literal URI, preserve raw HTTP evidence, detect duplicate keys and compare every approved field/value without PATCH or restart.
test_case.expected_result: The exact resource returns successful authenticated HTTP and valid unique-key JSON whose required fields and topology-specific current values satisfy the signed AMI policy contract.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed resource revision/schema/value matrix and complete match. Readability or jq success alone cannot pass. Wrong/missing fields, invalid combinations or value mismatch is FAIL after the oracle exists; absent oracle keeps Pending.
safety_gate: Verify certificate and BMC identity before authentication.
GET only; no PATCH, service/BMC restart or display manipulation.
Stop on unsupported resource, malformed/duplicate JSON or undefined value.
expected_evidence: TLS/client identity and HTTP status/headers/raw-body hash
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected; preserve transport/raw-body evidence and stop on any identity/schema ambiguity without corrective write or restart.
